Pharmacokinetics and tissue distribution of tripchlorolide in rodents using liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry. Tripchlorolide is a promising therapeutic compound with potent pharmacological activity and an improved safety profile compared to triptolide. However, its pharmacokinetics and tissue distribution remain poorly characterized. results.text: Pharmacokinetics-Based Safety Evaluation in Half-Dose Verteporfin Photodynamic Therapy.
